scripts.bench: npm run bench:app && npm run bench:delta && npm run bench:resort
scripts.bench:app: tsc test/needs-bench.ts test/delta-bench.ts --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target es2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir .bench --types node && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.bench/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')" && node -r ./test/shim.cjs .bench/test/needs-bench.js
scripts.bench:resort: tsc test/resort-bench.ts --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target es2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir .bench --types node && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.bench/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')" && node -r ./test/shim.cjs .bench/test/resort-bench.js
scripts.bench:delta: tsc test/needs-bench.ts test/delta-bench.ts --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target es2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir .bench --types node && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.bench/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}')" && node -r ./test/shim.cjs .bench/test/delta-bench.js
scripts.e2e:go: playwright test --project=webkit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/e2e.log | grep -v WebServer; grep -v WebServer /tmp/e2e.log | tail -60 | pbcopy; npm run ping --silent; echo; echo '--- done. the last 60 lines are on your clipboard, just paste ---'
scripts.ping: afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff & osascript -e 'display notification "Framehow: done — ready for you" with title "Framehow" sound name "Glass"'
